summary: Panel kit 5: chat history dialog from the kit
author: client
body:
Spec step 5. Replace Game2 frame 4 + Text frame 22 and the Game2 frame 7 thumb with compose + kit scrollbar.

Done when: scroll and drag behave as today.

comments.author: client
comments.body:
Chat history converted to a kit_dialog. Checkpoint 16738041 (panel_kit.cpp/.h, dialog_box_chat_history.cpp/.h).

Layout, from the approved rebuild (dialogs.py chat_history()):
- frame: dialog_size::chat_history, 364x162 (the original rect; the mockup was 362x164)
- title "History" at y 15, fill (144,16,12), with divider_wave flourishes 14 px out
- text area: inset (13,28,327,121) in stone_field
- scrollbar: kit groove and thumb in (340,28,15,121); thumb pos = 1 - scroll / (max - 8), so the newest line puts it at the bottom, as the sprite thumb did

Behaviour is unchanged:
- Scrolling, the track and its hit rects, and the press claim all stay in the dialog.
- There is no cc:: scroll control, so the scrollbar input is the dialog's own, as before.
- The sprite frame and thumb remain the fallback when the kit is missing.

Per-frame allocation removed from the kit draw path:
- flourish masks are resolved at load, not built from name + "_white" each draw
- kit_dialog::button(layout, ...) draws directly instead of building a kit_button
- kit_button keeps an optional custom style instead of copying the layout's style

Builds: Windows Debug with no new warnings; Linux client with 0 warnings; deployed.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Opens from the HUD Chat Log icon | verified |
| Messages show in the history colours | verified |
| Wheel scrolls the lines | verified |
| Wheel to the top moves the thumb to the top | verified |
| Thumb at the bottom for the newest line | verified |
| Journal clean | verified |
| Character dialog buttons after the kit_button change | verified |
| Thumb or track drag | unverified: needs the button held across frames; hb_mouse_down is rejected by the client ("unknown argument 'ctrl'"), and a bridge click does not register |
| Dragging the dialog | unverified, for the same reason |

The dialog has no hover controls.
